sample_unit: DECT studies (from different patients), each read with and without DL by 2 readers
models_evaluated: deep-learning algorithm for detecting green MSU pixelations on dual-energy CT

links.outcome: Reader time, diagnostic accuracy and confidence with versus without DL tool (paired reads, two readers)
links.effect: DL reduced reading time for trainee (p=0.02) but not attending (p=0.15); confidence unchanged (p=0.45); DL changed diagnosis in 3 cases, all correct with DL.
links.quote: The DL tool significantly reduced the reading time for the trainee radiologist (p = 0.02), but not for the attending radiologist (p = 0.15).

screen.reason: The study conducts a multi-reader study comparing radiologists reading dual-energy CT scans with versus without an AI detection tool to measure efficiency, confidence, and accuracy.
